body:
Founder uploaded LO_Formal_Grammar_Phase_0_Complete.md (authoritative Phase 0 consolidation) -- now the canonical spec. Real conflict flagged, not silently resolved: doc's §33 lists reaching outer LET bindings as out of v1 scope, but S221-01 already shipped it -- kept as tested superset. Implemented SWITCH/CASE/DEFAULT (nested if/= chain) and LAMBDA/CALL (reusing Let/LetRef depth-index scheme, single-arg v0). Verified end-to-end: SWITCH matches the doc's own worked example exactly; LAMBDA+CALL compiles a real IIFE fn literal through parena build+cc+execution, correct result. 26 tests total. LO commit 96201ed.

⚓ ☃
title: Real SWITCH/CASE/DEFAULT and LAMBDA/CALL support, verified end-to-end
